title: Private Vancouver Tour with Capilano Suspension Bridge
includes: Luggage Allowance (1 checked bag per person)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a fully private Vancouver Sightseeing and Capilano Suspension Bridge experience - designed exclusively for your group and your pace.

Unlike larger group tours, you won't be tied to a fixed schedule or waiting on others. Enjoy a smooth, flexible 5-hour experience where can spend more time at the places you love and more comfortably throughout the day.

Explore Vancouver's most iconic highlights, enjoying stops at Stanley Park's Totem Poles, Gastown’s famous Steam Clock, plus a scenic drive through Coal Harbour and historic Chinatown. Then head into nature at Capilano Suspension Bridge Park — cross the legendary bridge, explore the treetop walkways, and take in the views from the thrilling Cliffwalk.

A relaxed and well-paced experience, with a private guide, to make your experience feel more personal, comfortable, flexible, and tailored exclusively to your group.

PRIVATE TOUR HIGHLIGHTS: 
* Just your group
* Flexible stops - your call
* Optional extra time available
